research: Line: slate Kentucky -3; archive close -3.0 (open -1.5, moved toward Kentucky); Covers lists Kentucky -3.5 on game day (Covers preview, Nov 14 2026). Total fell 55.5 -> 52.5. Mild move toward Kentucky (helps Kentucky, priced).

[angle] Aaron Philo returns as Florida's starting QB after being benched earlier in the season (Covers, Nov 14 2026). A QB change back to a benched starter adds variance; it cuts both ways for Florida +3.
Florida is 1-4 SU and ATS since its upset of Ole Miss (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky.
Kentucky is 5-2 ATS in SEC play (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky (ATS records are priced; tiebreaker at most).
Florida is averaging 15.6 points per game since early October and lost 23-17 at home to Oklahoma as a 3.5-point favorite (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky.
[angle] Florida has trailed by 6+ at halftime in five straight games and covered only once in that stretch (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky.
Florida's defense ranks 122nd in defensive success rate (48.2%) and 132nd on third/fourth-down success (54.8%); it allows 32.4 ppg in SEC play (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky.
Kentucky's defense ranks 96th in defensive success rate (45.8%), so it is not a lockdown unit either (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Florida +3.
Kentucky ranks 21st in havoc rate (18.9%) and 7th in interceptions (12), a bad matchup for a recently benched QB (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky.
Kentucky QB Kenny Minchey at 77.8% adjusted completion; Kentucky OL 16th in success rate (49.2%) (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Kentucky.
[angle] Florida RB Jadan Baugh is top 10 nationally in forced missed tackles (48), which matters against a Kentucky defense that ranks 96th in success rate (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Florida.
Florida WR Vernell Brown III is out (has not played since Ole Miss) per SEC availability report (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Known well before kickoff, so priced. Slight help Kentucky.
Weather not expected to be a factor; Covers writer (Rob Paul) takes Kentucky -3.5 and Over 52.5 (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Preview picks are priced.
games.reasoning: Florida's offense has been poor since October and its defense is worse, so Kentucky by about 5 is my number. That is only 2 points past the -3, and Florida's struggles are already in the line and the move from -1.5. The angle is Philo returning after his benching against Kentucky's ball-hawking defense. A clear confirmation that Philo was worse than his replacement this season would have pushed it toward a Kentucky lean.

research: Line: slate Utah -1.5 (Arizona +1.5); archive close Arizona +2.5, moved slightly toward Utah. Total rose sharply from 51.5 to 56.5 (archive). Covers shows Utah -1.5, total 55.5 on game day (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Utah slightly (priced).
Utah is 9-0 and ranked No. 2 (slate; Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Utah.

[angle] Utah has survived several close calls: BYU had a 59.7% win probability in the third quarter and lost by one score after four turnovers. Houston had a 74.7% win probability in the second half before three fourth-quarter turnovers. Colorado led 17-13 in the third quarter (Covers, Nov 14 2026). This suggests Utah's record flatters it, which helps Arizona.
Utah QB Devon Dampier has 20 TD and 7 INT. He went 32-of-52 for 381 yards, 2 TD and 2 INT combined against Houston and BYU (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Middling recent passing helps Arizona.

[angle] Dampier averaged 4.0 yards per attempt under pressure vs 8.3 when kept clean in 2025, and in 2026 the split cited is a 52.4% completion rate and 7-to-4 TD-to-INT ratio (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Arizona generated a 39.3% pressure rate vs Texas Tech, which helps Arizona.
Arizona's defense ranks 34th in success rate allowed (Covers Intel, Nov 14 2026). Helps Arizona.
Arizona has hit the moneyline in 8 of its last 11 games (+5.75 units) (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Arizona (a priced trend).

[angle] Kickoff was moved from 7:30 PM to 10:30 PM ET after a Friday FAA ground stop, which could have disrupted Utah's travel. The game is a late home night game in Tucson, forecast mid-60s with no rain (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Slight help to Arizona.
Kalshi had Utah as only a 52% favorite (Covers, Nov 14 2026). The market sees this as a near coin flip.
The Covers writer (Nick Galaida) takes Arizona +2.5 and the Under 54.5 (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Preview picks are priced.
No injury details were available on the preview page (Covers injuries link only). Thin on availability for both sides, so confidence is lower.
games.reasoning: This is a near pick'em at -1.5, and my number of Utah by about 1 is inside the 2-point pass band. The angle is Utah's 9-0 record, built on opponents' late turnovers, against a good Arizona pass rush. That points to Arizona, but forced underdogs in near pick'em games have been the weakest cell, and the close moved toward Utah. Injury clarity on either QB would have changed it.

research: Line: slate Iowa -17.5; archive close -19.5 (open -16.5). Predictem had Iowa -16.5 on Nov 11, so the line climbed about 3 points during the week (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). The move favors Iowa and is priced.

[angle] Purdue fired defensive coordinator Kevin Kane after the 34-29 loss to Maryland. Head coach Barry Odom said 'I feel responsible' (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Midseason staff turmoil could go either way.
Purdue allows 32.3 ppg (124th in FBS) and 6.7 yards per play (131st), and ranks 117th against the run (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Iowa.
Iowa allows 12.2 ppg (3rd nationally), ranks 5th against the run, averages 3.33 sacks a game and allows third-down conversions only 29.1% of the time (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Iowa.
Iowa is 6-3 ATS (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Iowa (priced).
Purdue has lost three straight; it beat Minnesota 41-13 a month earlier (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Iowa.
Iowa shut out Wisconsin 30-0, then won at Northwestern with L.J. Phillips Jr. rushing for 128 yards in his first start (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Iowa.

Iowa QB Hank Brown went 36-of-45 for 348 yards and 3 TD over his last two games; Iowa averages 173.8 rushing yards a game (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). That is efficient but low-volume, and Iowa is a defense-first favorite, which per LESSONS argues against laying a big number. Helps Purdue +17.5.
[angle] Iowa's kickoff return unit leads the nation at 47 yards per return, a hidden source of field position (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Iowa.
Purdue QB Ryan Browne has 2,260 passing yards, and Purdue scored 29 against Maryland (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Purdue can put up some points, which helps the backdoor for Purdue +17.5.
[angle] Iowa has won 24 of its last 29 November games and eight straight night games since 2022 (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). This is old history and doesn't decide anything. Slight help Iowa.
The Predictem writer takes Iowa -16.5 with a projected score of Iowa 34, Purdue 13 (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Preview picks are priced. No injuries were reported in the preview.
games.reasoning: The mismatch, Iowa's elite defense against Purdue's 124th-ranked scoring defense, is real but fully priced: the line climbed from -16.5 to -19.5. My Iowa-by-19 is inside the band of both the slate and the close. Iowa is a defense-first favorite, which LESSONS warns against laying big numbers with, but fading on that alone hasn't worked. The angle is Purdue's midweek DC firing. Knowing who ran Purdue's defense and how would have mattered.

Total moved from 47.5 to 46.5 (slate file). Neutral.

No Covers preview found at the built URL (404), and the Predictem sitemaps listed no UNLV-New Mexico preview for this date. I did not search further, to avoid leaks (WebSearch avoided per the Week 10 rule).

[angle] Predictem's sitemap lists a later New Mexico preview ('Mountain West title race', Nov 20). I did not open it because it would recap this game. It confirms only that New Mexico was in the title race context, which applies to both teams.
Fewer than 10 solid bullets exist for this game. Research was too thin to make a read, so confidence is a pass.
games.reasoning: No pre-game preview could be found without risky searching, so I have no read. The line's 6-point move toward New Mexico is priced and is not a reason either way. The forced side follows the market (the close is 2 points past the slate), not any evidence.

research: Line: slate LSU -4.5; archive close -5.5, a move toward LSU. The total collapsed from 54.5 to 47.5 (archive), and Covers shows 46.5 on game day (Covers, Nov 14 2026). The moves favor LSU and are priced.
Texas has covered three straight, two of them against Top 25 teams, and has outscored opponents 99-50 since its loss to Florida (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Texas (ATS records are priced).
LSU has failed to cover in all three of its games against ranked opponents (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Texas.
LSU's offense scored 24 vs Ole Miss and 13 vs Alabama. QB Sam Leavitt had 3 TD and 3 INT and was sacked nine times across three games vs ranked opponents (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Texas.
Texas defense: No. 1 nationally in net adjusted EPA per play (-0.29), No. 3 in available yards % (31.3%), No. 11 in havoc (20%) (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Texas +4.5.
LSU defense: No. 3 in sacks (36), No. 4 in havoc rate (22.2%), No. 4 in net adjusted EPA per play (-0.23) (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps LSU.

[angle] Arch Manning has a 4% turnover-worthy play rate (11th-highest) and a 27.2% pressure-to-sack rate (5th-highest in the P4). That rate meets the No. 3 sack defense, a real matchup problem for Texas's offense (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps LSU.
[angle] Texas DE Colin Simmons is a full go this week (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Texas's pass rush faces an LSU line that allowed nine sacks vs ranked teams. Helps Texas.
Texas RB Raleek Brown has 346 scrimmage yards and 3 TD during the three-game win streak (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Texas.
Under is 5-1 in LSU's last six home games vs a team with a winning road record (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Neutral for the side.
[angle] No. 8 Texas is a 4.5-5.5 point underdog at No. 24 LSU. The market rates LSU clearly above the rankings, at night in Tiger Stadium (slate; Kalshi LSU 61%, per Covers Nov 14 2026). Helps LSU.
The Covers writer (Rob Paul) takes Texas +4.5 and Under 46.5 (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Preview picks are priced.
games.reasoning: Two elite defenses and a total that dropped 7 points make a close, low-scoring game likely. My LSU by 3 points to Texas, but it is under 2 points from the slate number and further inside the close (-5.5). The key matchup cuts both ways: Manning's sack and turnover-worthy rates against LSU's pass rush, and LSU's struggling offense against the No. 1 defense. A low total 'making points worth more' is not a reason per LESSONS. Clear news on either QB's health would have changed it.

research: Line: slate South Carolina -7.5 (Arkansas +7.5); archive close Arkansas +6.5. Predictem said it opened as high as 8.5 (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Money moved toward Arkansas, which is priced.

[angle] South Carolina QB LaNorris Sellers is playing through an ankle injury. Shane Beamer expects him to play (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). That limits his running threat, which helps Arkansas; it was known all week and is likely part of the move to 6.5.
[angle] Look-ahead spot: Georgia visits South Carolina next week, and Beamer felt the need to warn that you can lose any Saturday (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps Arkansas.
South Carolina has won four straight, most recently a 17-9 win over Texas A&M (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps South Carolina.

Arkansas is 3-6 and has lost four of five, including 34-10 at home to Missouri, 26-23 at Auburn and a 7-point loss to Tennessee (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Its close losses suggest it is competitive in some spots, which helps Arkansas +7.5 a little.
Arkansas averages 20 ppg, last in the SEC, and QB K.J. Jackson went 14-of-30 at Auburn (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps South Carolina.
South Carolina's turnover margin is -7 (127th nationally) (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). That gives a laying favorite more variance, which helps Arkansas.
Sellers is 2nd in the SEC in total offense (304.1 ypg). South Carolina scores on 90.9% of red-zone trips, and Arkansas ranks 105th in red-zone defense (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps South Carolina.
South Carolina WR Chris Marshall is 3rd in the SEC in receiving yards per game (87) (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Helps South Carolina.
[angle] Arkansas is under first-year head coach Ryan Silverfield in a losing season at home, with motivation uncertain (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Unclear direction.
The Predictem writer (Joe Jensen) takes Arkansas +7.5 and projects South Carolina 27, Arkansas 23 (Predictem, Nov 11 2026). Preview picks are priced.
games.reasoning: My South Carolina by 6 is 1.5 points from the slate number and right on the close, so it's a pass. Arkansas's poor offense against South Carolina's red-zone efficiency is balanced by Sellers' ankle, South Carolina's -7 turnover margin and the look-ahead to Georgia (the best angle). The move to 6.5 says the market already leans that way. A Sellers downgrade on the final report would have pushed it to Arkansas.

research: Line: slate Oklahoma State -3.5; archive close -4.5. The total soared from 61.5 to 74.5 in the archive, and Covers shows 73.5 (Covers, Nov 14 2026). The move favors Oklahoma State and is priced.

[angle] No. 10 Texas Tech, the reigning Big 12 champion, is an underdog at unranked Oklahoma State. The Covers writer expects the public on Tech (Covers, Nov 14 2026). The market rates Oklahoma State higher than the poll does, which helps Oklahoma State.
Oklahoma State ranks 16th in schedule-adjusted net EPA per play vs Texas Tech's 32nd (GameOnPaper via Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Oklahoma State.
Early-down success rate differential: Oklahoma State +9.1% vs Texas Tech +8.5% (CollegeFootballData via Covers, Nov 14 2026). Near even.
Oklahoma State QB Drew Mestemaker leads the Big 12 in passer efficiency rating (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Oklahoma State.
Oklahoma State's explosive-play rate is in the 81st percentile, while Texas Tech's defense is in the 38th percentile against explosives (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Oklahoma State.
Oklahoma State is 5-1 ATS in Big 12 games (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Helps Oklahoma State (priced).
Texas Tech is 2-7 ATS in first halves, 0-3 on the road (Covers, Nov 14 2026). Slight help to Oklahoma State.
[angle] Oklahoma State upset Oregon in Week 2 as a 24-point underdog (Covers, Nov 14 2026). That shows its ceiling, but it is old.

The teams are a combined 11-1 to the Over in conference play. Texas Tech is 9th and Oklahoma State 16th nationally in seconds per play (Covers, Nov 14 2026). A high-possession game adds variance, which slightly helps the underdog.
[angle] Weather: about 47F, 11 mph wind and a 47% chance of rain in Stillwater (Covers, Nov 14 2026). That could slow two fast-paced passing offenses and cuts both ways.
Texas Tech QB Thomas Castellanos starts; the preview listed no injury details (Covers, Nov 14 2026). The writer (Geoff Clark) takes Oklahoma State -3.5 and Over 72.5; preview picks are priced.
games.reasoning: The efficiency numbers favor Oklahoma State, and my Oklahoma State by 4.5 matches the close. It is only 1 point past the slate's -3.5, so it's a pass. The most interesting angle is the market pricing an unranked home team over the No. 10 reigning champion. The 13-point total spike and possible rain add variance rather than a side. A clear Texas Tech injury would have been needed for a pick.
